notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Boros Garrison.
Boros Garrison does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Boros Garrison.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Boros Garrison to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Boros Garrison.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Boros Garrison.
Repeat.
